learner_program_enrollments_lifecycle_ck.name: learner_program_enrollments_lifecycle_ck
learner_program_enrollments_lifecycle_ck.value:
("learner_program_enrollments"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "learner_program_enrollments"."completed_at" is null and "learner_program_enrollments"."withdrawn_at" is null)
          or ("learner_program_enrollments"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "learner_program_enrollments"."completed_at" is not null and "learner_program_enrollments"."withdrawn_at" is null)
          or ("learner_program_enrollments"."status" = 'WITHDRAWN' and "learner_program_enrollments"."withdrawn_at" is not null and "learner_program_enrollments"."completed_at" is null)

section_enrollments_lifecycle_ck.name: section_enrollments_lifecycle_ck
section_enrollments_lifecycle_ck.value:
("section_enrollments"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "section_enrollments"."ended_at" is null)
          or ("section_enrollments"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' and "section_enrollments"."ended_at" is not null)

lesson_contents_shape_ck.name: lesson_contents_shape_ck
lesson_contents_shape_ck.value:
(
        ("lesson_contents"."content_type" = 'RESOURCE'
          and ("lesson_contents"."notes" is not null or "lesson_contents"."external_url" is not null or "lesson_contents"."storage_key" is not null)
          and "lesson_contents"."duration_seconds" is null
          and "lesson_contents"."starts_at" is null and "lesson_contents"."ends_at" is null)
        or
        ("lesson_contents"."content_type" = 'VIDEO'
          and "lesson_contents"."storage_key" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."external_url" is null
          and "lesson_contents"."duration_seconds" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."starts_at" is null and "lesson_contents"."ends_at" is null)
        or
        ("lesson_contents"."content_type" = 'YOUTUBE'
          and "lesson_contents"."external_url" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."storage_key" is null
          and "lesson_contents"."duration_seconds" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."starts_at" is null and "lesson_contents"."ends_at" is null)
        or
        ("lesson_contents"."content_type" = 'LIVE_CLASS'
          and "lesson_contents"."external_url" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."storage_key" is null
          and "lesson_contents"."duration_seconds" is null
          and "lesson_contents"."starts_at" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."ends_at" is not null
          and "lesson_contents"."ends_at" > "lesson_contents"."starts_at")
      )
